title: Psychological traits and their explanation: A 20-year perspective from Reinforcement Sensitivity Theory
title_zh: 心理特质及其解释：基于强化敏感性理论的20年视角
abstract: Reinforcement Sensitivity Theory (RST) attributes certain personality traits to sensitivities of neural systems based on a detailed long-lasting neuropsychology of state control. (First book-length edition, 1982, 3rd edition, 2024). However, for trait system sensitivities, within-system details can largely be ignored. Here we provide an overview of the systems for personality researchers. We also extended the underdeveloped personality aspects of the neuropsychology. In the process of producing this extension, we discovered various lacunae in personality theory as a whole (and the role of scientific explanation within it) that has led us to start the paper with a detailed exposition of application of levels of explanation to personality, the role of emergence in such explanations, and (we believe) a resolution among the different schools of personality research (lexical, rational, neural). [128/250].
abstract_zh: 强化敏感性理论（RST）将某些人格特质归因于基于长期神经心理学的状态控制的神经系统敏感性。（第一本书长版，1982年，第三版，2024年）。然而，对于特质系统敏感性，系统内部细节可以大幅忽略。本文为人格研究者提供了系统概览，并扩展了神经心理学中未充分发展的个性方面。在扩展过程中，我们发现了人格理论整体（以及其中科学解释的作用）存在的各种空白，这促使我们在论文开头详细阐述了层级解释在人格中的应用、出现性在此类解释中的作用，并（我们认为）在不同人格研究学派（词汇、理性、神经）之间达成了调和。
